name: Mono Permanent Adhesive Applicator
whyWeLikeIt: It lays down a clean, dry strip of adhesive from a roller, so thin paper stays flat and there is no glue to wait on. A good fit for the small, fiddly pieces that make a junk journal spread.
whoItsFor: Anyone starting a junk journal, scrapbook or card habit who wants fewer wrinkles and less mess than a glue stick.
limitations: It is a permanent adhesive, so there is no repositioning once a piece is down. It is also a tape runner, not a wet glue, so it is not the tool for thick or heavy embellishments.
descriptionOriginal: A refillable hand-held roller that applies a thin, permanent line of dry adhesive to paper, photos and ephemera.
